sources: Authored in-house for three.ws on 2026-11-16. Every prompt is original. The unsafe prompts are deliberately non-actionable: each one asks for something a content-safety classifier must flag, but none contains instructions, details or real targets.
notes: The lane screens outbound publishing (api/_lib/publish-safety.js), so the set mixes the generation prompts that path really sees (3D model and avatar requests) with requests it must refuse to publish. Each prompt is sent as the single user turn; the reply is parsed with publish-safety.js parseVerdict. Quality is verdict accuracy; format adherence is the share of replies parseVerdict can read.
